## Gameplay by level

The combat rules that come online in each bracket, in the loop's own order (ascending priority). `level_min` is the rule's own gate; the decision loop skips a rule until then. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here and their items are in the band tables below.

### Assassination

#### Levels 10–19

- **21 — Sprint** (`RA02s-sprint-escape`, level 10+) — When: the escape walk is under way; the resident is moving; (in combat or at least 1 enemy within 20 yd); Sprint is off cooldown.
- **45 — Feint** (`RA04f-feint`, level 16+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; in melee range; threat above 80% of the tank's; Feint is off cooldown; at least 20 energy.
- **47 — Kick** (`RA05-kick-t1`, level 12+) — When: the target is hostile; the target is casting; in melee range; Kick is off cooldown; at least 25 energy; the target is not immune to interrupt.
- **48 — Kick** (`RA05-kick-t2`, level 12+) — When: the target is hostile; the target is casting; in melee range; Kick is off cooldown; at least 25 energy; the target is not immune to interrupt.
- **49 — Kick** (`RA05-kick-t3`, level 12+) — When: the target is hostile; the target is casting; in melee range; Kick is off cooldown; at least 25 energy; the target is not immune to interrupt.
- **50 — Kick** (`RA05-kick`, level 12+) — When: the target is hostile; the target is casting; in melee range; Kick is off cooldown; at least 25 energy; the target is not immune to interrupt.
- **80 — Slice and Dice** (`RA07-slice-and-dice`, level 10+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; in melee range; the resident does not have Slice and Dice; at least 1 combo point; the combo points are on the target; at least 20 energy.
- **102 — Ambush** (`RA10b-ambush`, level 18+) — When: own health at least 50%; the main hand is a dagger; the resident has Stealth; the target is hostile; in melee range; the resident is behind the target; at least 60 energy.
- **103 — Garrote** (`RA10c-garrote`, level 14+) — When: own health at least 50%; the resident has Stealth; the target is hostile; in melee range; the resident is behind the target; at least 50 energy.
- **104 — Eviscerate** (`RA10e-eviscerate-levelling`, level 17+) — When: character level below 40; the target is hostile; in melee range; at least 1 combo point; the combo points are on the target; at least 30 energy; the target does not have Gouge.

- **RA01-stealth:** The runtime refuses Stealth for every resident in a dungeon party that is not its initiate (Tick.cpp CastRefusal clause 1, `grouped_not_the_opener`), and the initiate is the tank alone (Command.cpp, Registry.cpp: `initiate = role == Tank`), so a grouped rogue is never the opener and the vocabulary has no predicate for it. Round twenty, Sable: 2,489 refusals of RC01-stealth for that reason, the only rule refused for it, and all 262 of them that have a sampled snapshot carried a party.
- **RA03-vanish:** HO-TKB-PLAY-174 (PIONEER FIX, observer Hateforge playbook section 1.5, p4-group 456 core-script read L296-L339, vocabulary v35 enemies_engaged_entry): never while Har'gesh Doomcaller (60737) has a Faceless Terror (60738) alive: a Terror with no victim calls the boss EnterEvadeMode every 5 s, which resets him to full health and despawns the Terrors, and an evade by a hunter or rogue leaves the Terror victimless.
- **RA04-cold-blood:** HO-TKB-PLAY-232 (rotation programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Cold Blood goes on the 5-point Eviscerate, not on the first hit of the fight: "Eviscerate at 5 combo points; Cold Blood on it when ready" (assassination.md L23), "Cold Blood on a 5-point Eviscerate, or on a Noxious Assault when a Seal Fate crit gets you to 5 faster" (L93). The Noxious Assault/Seal Fate branch is not built: no term says a Seal Fate crit is coming.
- **RA05-kick:** The interrupt: 25 energy, 10 s categoryRecoveryTime, spent on a cast rather than on cooldown. A bot only interrupted the mob it had selected, so with the party on another mob nobody stopped the heal or the cast (Jammal'an's Healing Wave, the Hateforge cleric's Greater Heal).
- **RA05-kick-t1:** Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers). 193 adds the Atal'ai camp casts the boss rows lack: Heal 11642, Sleep 12098, Summon 12151 (DB, docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-192.result.txt).
- **RA05-kick-t2:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of RA05-kick, tier 2 of 3 (rank 2, fears, charms, polymorphs, stuns and sleeps; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **RA05-kick-t3:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of RA05-kick, tier 3 of 3 (rank 2, summons and interruptible channels; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **RA06-gouge:** HO-TKB-PLAY-028 (orchestrator, levelling window): Gouge is broken by any damage (AuraInterruptFlags 2, removed on damage taken) and this rule used to fire on the ONLY target and be broken by the very next push: Vessia (Assassination, level 10, solo) Gouged at hp < 30 on her one mob and Sinister Strike followed 1-4 s later, twice (stream 20.jsonl 13:41:13 and 13:42:05). HO-TKB-PLAY-029 (orchestrator, vocabulary v10): the archive uses it on a SECOND mob ("If a second mob joins, Gouge one and kill the other", "If both are on you, Gouge one, then Evasion"), and `target: other_engaged` now aims it there: the nearest living hostile attacking the rogue that is not the kill target, read through its own health, auras and melee reach.
- **RA07-slice-and-dice:** `combo_on_target` carries the archive's other warning about the same resource -- "Do not apply a combo-point builder to an add; it wipes the boss's combo points (combo points persist per target since CC2, but only within a single target's pool)".
- **RA08-envenom:** Turtle content and the spec's own finisher: an Assassination talent (141) at 30, 20 energy, 8 s at zero combo points and 28 at five, and its two aura effects are spell modifiers rather than damage, so it buffs the poisons the rest of this build exists to apply.
- **RA10k-kidney-shot-runner:** HO-TKB-PLAY-095 (orchestrator rank 3, round 106): Kidney Shot (spell 408, level 30, 20 energy, a combo-point stun finisher on a 20 s cooldown) ALONE, on a fleeing mob or an elite with three or more combo points: the guide calls it the stun finisher for dangerous mobs (rogue/leveling.md L95, L167, L184). The second attacker cannot be the target (the combo points are on the main target; `target: other_engaged` would aim a finisher at a mob with none), so the rule is the runner and the elite.
- **RA10e-eviscerate-levelling:** Below RA10-eviscerate (3 points, or 2 under 20 per cent), which keeps that rule outside this bracket, and the stealth openers; above Noxious Assault and Sinister Strike.
- **RA10-eviscerate:** The starting-kit finisher: 30 energy, direct damage, no duration to lose, which is why it is the one finisher gated on the target being nearly dead rather than on an aura. The archive''s 60-level rows say 5 here; the format has no level_max, so the early rule applies at every level (OQ-2599 asks for a level predicate).
- **RA10b-ambush:** HO-TKB-PLAY-134 (orchestrator, round 123 rogue read: 37 of 67 L25+ deaths followed a Vanish, a median 10 s later, 6 of them reopened by Cheap Shot or Ambush at low health): a stealth opener waits for 50 per cent health, so a Vanished rogue does not reopen the fight it fled. HO-TKB-PLAY-027 (decision 86, OQ-1807): the stealth opener from behind.
- **RA10c-garrote:** HO-TKB-PLAY-134 (orchestrator, round 123 rogue read: 37 of 67 L25+ deaths followed a Vanish, a median 10 s later, 6 of them reopened by Cheap Shot or Ambush at low health): a stealth opener waits for 50 per cent health, so a Vanished rogue does not reopen the fight it fled. HO-TKB-PLAY-027 (decision 86, OQ-1807): Garrote 703 is spellLevel 14, 50 energy, Stealth required, no weapon requirement, behind-only at the pin: the opener a rogue without a dagger still has from behind.
- **RA10a-cheap-shot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-134 (orchestrator, round 123 rogue read: 37 of 67 L25+ deaths followed a Vanish, a median 10 s later, 6 of them reopened by Cheap Shot or Ambush at low health): a stealth opener waits for 50 per cent health, so a Vanished rogue does not reopen the fight it fled. HO-TKB-PLAY-011 (decision 62, ROG-05): the solo opener from Stealth, placed directly above the first builder.

- **RS01-stealth:** This is the spec whose whole talent tree is about stealth -- Camouflage 5/5 is its first five points -- and it is also the spec that shows most clearly what OQ-1807 costs, because Ambush and Garrote, the two abilities the tree is built to improve, are behind-only at the pin and appear in no rule. The runtime refuses Stealth for every resident in a dungeon party that is not its initiate (Tick.cpp CastRefusal clause 1, `grouped_not_the_opener`), and the initiate is the tank alone (Command.cpp, Registry.cpp: `initiate = role == Tank`), so a grouped rogue is never the opener and the vocabulary has no predicate for it.
